newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T denies building ITC stake.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T denies building ITC stake.

text.p: Britain's B.A.T Industries Plc is not building a stake in India's ITC, a spokesman from B.A.T said on Thursday in response to Indian newspaper reports.
"If we were building a stake in ITC, we would not do it through the foreign investor route in the stockmarket," said the spokesman for B.A.T.
Indian newspapers had reported that BAT had bought 700,000 ITC shares in an effort to increase its 31 percent stake in the company.
"What we aim to do is to restore a normal working relationship with ITC," the spokesman said.
Indian newspapers and markets have reported that B.A.T planned to increase its stake to in ITC from the present 31.8 percent to 40-45 percent.
